android.desc:
COL Reminder is a reminder application for your Android phone. 

Install the Wear OS app to receive notifications directly on your watch.

★ Text Reminders
★ Telephone Call Reminders
★ Parking Time Reminders with Countdown
★ Birthday Reminders
★ Location-Based Reminders
★ Google Drive Backup

Available in over 40 languages!
(English, German, Italian, French, Swedish, Spanish, Chinese, Polish, Korean, Hungarian, Turkish, Czech, Slovak, etc.)

It helps you remember the things you don't want to forget. 
Please do not confuse it with a to-do list.

Do you want some examples?

★ Need to make an urgent phone call tomorrow?
No problem with COL Reminder. Just set up a call reminder, and the app will notify you exactly when you need to make the call. With just one tap, the number is dialed automatically.

★ Need to do something urgent at home?
No problem with COL Reminder. Just set up a text reminder, and you will get the notification at the exact time.

★ Don't want to miss your best friends' birthdays?
No problem with COL Reminder. Just set up a birthday reminder for your most important friends, and you will be notified a few days before—and, of course, on the birthday itself.

★ Need a reminder for your parking time (short-term parking zone)?
No problem with COL Reminder. Just set up the parking reminder and never pay for a parking ticket again.

quotes.text:
For anyone on Android, I never missed any task when I was using COL Reminder [0] which has repeat reminders until you mark something done.

Now I'm using iOS the closest I've found is Due [1] but it's exactly like you said, iPhone notifications are more transient and I have missed stuff.

> The system would be able to nag me more if I do not ack

This is where iOS isn't great, Due seems to get silenced or killed off if it creates too many notifications. So it would be better if there was a nagging service running somewhere else than the phone itself. Maybe an email based nag service would work, something that when a task is due it sends an email every hour until you reply saying "done" or "snooze 1 day" or whatever.

edit: Found an email based nag service - https://www.followupthen.com/how#tasks

[0]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.colapps.reminder&hl=en_US&gl=US

[1]: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/due-reminders-timers/id390017969
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Task system that requires ack
